standouts.head: 3 of the desk's strategy kinds buying
standouts.text: The desk's own strategies signaled a buy: 3 kinds of strategy.
standouts.learn: The desk's own trading rules; when several kinds agree on a name, the read counts it.

standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram falling.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: Resistance +0.2% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +0.2% above (0.1 ATR): the Jul 7 high, the Aug 20 low and the Sep 1 low: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

against.head: A thin rise
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 53% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Sep 3 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement, it is one straight leg and it is too quick for the advance before it. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Mar 24, 2023–Sep 3 advance (−30% to −39%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the January high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: Support −0.7% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −0.7% below (0.5 ATR), where 7 levels (4 kinds) meet: the January breakout level, the most-traded price of six months and the 61.8% retracement of the Sep 3–Oct 1 drop.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Pullback in an uptrend
material.text: Price has dipped toward its 50-day average but holds above the rising 200-day, with the 50-day above the 200-day.
material.learn: A dip inside an uptrend; buyers often return at support.
